description: This file defines a React component for a 'New Chat' interface in a chat application, including UI elements, hooks for managing masks, and logic for initiating new chat sessions.

classes.name: MaskItem
classes.description: A React component representing a selectable mask item with avatar and name.

methods.name: useMaskGroup
methods.description: A custom hook that groups masks into rows based on the container's size.

methods.name: startChat
methods.description: Function to initiate a new chat session, optionally with a selected mask.
